title: Receipt shows the real shop
problem: The receipt always said Dazzle Shop with no address, phone, BIN or warranty.
now: The receipt prints the shop from Settings › General, the BIN, and a warranty line under each IMEI item.
steps: Change the store name in Settings › General
Sell a Realme phone at the POS
Check name, BIN and warranty line on the receipt
notes: Where: POS › receipt after a sale · /pos

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
